Does Brad Pitt die in Happy Feet Two?

He plays Will the Krill, a voice role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. A krill who refuses to be eaten and becomes a legend.

Will, an existentially restless krill, drags his friend Bill (Matt Damon) away from the swarm to climb the food chain, only to learn he's at the very bottom of it. After a series of near-misses with whales and predators, a humbled Will reunites with Bill and the swarm, where they're hailed as legends for their journey. In the finale Will and the krill join the penguins, elephant seals and Sven in the mass effort to shatter the iceberg trapping the emperor penguins.

Comic side plot; despite being prey, neither krill is eaten. Animated voice role.
